disclaimer: Evidence for the listed IT General Controls relevant to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) financial reporting, generated from the gateway's audit trail and egress data-classification records for the period shown. This is supporting evidence for specific controls — not a SOX audit, a management assertion under §302/§404, or an attestation. Each figure reflects only what the gateway observes; it does not assert completeness of the underlying systems.

controls.title: Access to programs & data — authenticated, authorized access
controls.requirement: Access to financial systems and data is restricted to authenticated and authorized users and services.
controls.howSatisfied: Every request is identity-verified and evaluated by the policy decision point (PDP) before access; delegated access to financial workflows uses short-lived on-behalf-of tokens bound to the root human.

evidence.label: Audit events attributed to a human identity

controls.title: Access provisioning — registration & approval before access
controls.requirement: Users and automated identities are registered and approved before being granted access to financial systems.
controls.howSatisfied: Agents are registered in the identity registry and must be approved before they can act; unapproved identities are denied at the boundary.

controls.title: Least privilege — enforced allow-sets
controls.requirement: Access is granted on a least-privilege basis, restricted to the capabilities each agent actually needs.
controls.howSatisfied: Capability profiles and Cedar policies restrict each agent to an explicit allow-set; recorded denials show the restriction is actively enforced rather than advisory.

controls.title: Change management — controls are tracked & documented
controls.requirement: Changes to access policies and data-handling controls are tracked and documented.
controls.howSatisfied: Access policies carry authorship and source (manual, generated, or system default) with change timestamps; egress data-classification rules are tenant-scoped configuration recorded the same way.

controls.title: Data confidentiality — sensitive & financial data egress monitoring
controls.requirement: Sensitive and financial information leaving the system is identified, classified, and monitored so that its exposure can be reviewed.
controls.howSatisfied: Every response returned through the gateway is inspected by the egress post-processor and labelled with a data category and sensitivity; financial and restricted data is surfaced for monitoring.

controls.title: Computer operations — audit trail over financial data access
controls.requirement: Security- and financial-relevant events are recorded to an audit trail supporting monitoring and after-the-fact review.
controls.howSatisfied: Requests, decisions, token issuances, and classified data egress are recorded to the gateway's audit trail; access to sensitive data is attributed to the root human on whose behalf it occurred.

evidence.label: Classified egress attributed to a human (of total)
